fact: In October 2018 UNDP handed the source code of the National Registration and Identification System (NRIS) to the National Registration Bureau, giving the Bureau ownership of the system's core software, per Malawi24.
The National Registration Bureau, per its Principal Secretary, will renew, print and distribute about two million expired National ID cards nationwide.
The deck says the National Registration Bureau, a government department, manages the national civil registration and digital identity issuance system.
